items.text: Nico Collins hurt his hamstring during Wednesday's practice (Houston Chronicle). Missed five games on a hammy in 2024. Crucial MRI results expected tomorrow. Week 1 routes on 42 Stroud dropbacks: Collins 37, Hutchinson 29, Boutte 27.
items.why: Hamstring injury during practice; history of missing time; high route volume prior week.
items.implication: Monitor MRI; if out, Houston WR targets redistribute heavily.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets for Hutchinson/Boutte if limited or out.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow dealing with back tightness, did not practice Wednesday, but expects to play Sunday at Houston.
items.why: Back tightness; mental reps; self-reports expects to play.
items.implication: Likely active; monitor Thursday/Friday practice. CIN pass game intact if plays.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (rib) will not practice Wednesday (Harbaugh). Early negative sign.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1; no practice Wednesday.
items.implication: Game-time or possible miss; Tre Harris primary beneficiary.
items.opportunity: Tre Harris routes/targets if McConkey limited/out.

items.text: A.J. Brown to IR (high-ankle sprain); out at least 4 games. ETR lists beneficiaries Romeo Doubs, DeMario Douglas. Confirmed across reports.
items.why: High-ankle sprain from Week 1; IR designation.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining NE pass-catchers.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) was a full participant in Wednesday practice, indication he could return Sunday.
items.why: Full participant after ankle issue; positive return indicator.
items.implication: Likely plays; volatile FLEX behind Stevenson; committee risk.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey did not practice Wednesday due to a hamstring injury.
items.implication: Monitor; if out, DEN RB committee shifts (J.K. Dobbins/others).
items.opportunity: Increased work for backups if missed.

items.text: Jameson Williams had the 8th-most expected fantasy points at WR in Week 1. He simply played a horrific game.
items.why: High xFP (targets/location/depth) but poor conversion; process over results.
items.implication: Positive regression candidate; opportunity was elite.
items.opportunity: Target share and aDOT sustain upside.

items.text: Ravens placing WR Ja’Kobi Lane on IR after wrist surgery; out four games.
items.why: Wrist surgery to quicken recovery; designated IR.
items.opportunity: Rashod Bateman primary beneficiary for snaps/routes.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a waiver wire target this week (FF Happy Hour). Beneficiaries from 49ers WR injuries including Stribling surgery.
items.why: Stribling out ~10 weeks post-surgery creates path; Deebo already on roster/elevated opportunity.
items.implication: Top waiver add for WR depth/upside in 49ers offense.

items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has a legit chance to return Week 2 or 3. But same left knee that had PCL sprain and bone bruise last season. Scary.
items.why: Coach positive on work; meniscus debridement timeline short but prior PCL concern.
items.implication: Potential TE1 if back early; monitor practice.
items.opportunity: If active, immediate high target share.

items.text: As expected, Kenneth Walker went to KC to be a true workhorse. Handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities, ran 19 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks, tied for team-high 6 targets (22% share). 23-173-1 rush, 3-18-1 rec.
items.why: Near-total early RB opps + high route/target share in debut confirms three-down role.
items.implication: Locked RB1; elite opportunity in Chiefs offense.
items.opportunity: Carries, routes, targets, goal-line; handcuff Emmett Johnson.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty UPGRADES to high-end RB1 (Fantasy Life Utilization via Berry endorsement). 73% snaps, 70% rushes, 61% routes, 21% targets, 23 att/6 tgt, 156 yfs, 2 rec TDs. Tied Bijan for top RB Util Score.
items.why: Every-down role confirmed; improved YBC/YAC; historical comps elite PPG.
items.implication: Hold/start as top RB; ROS bullish under Kubiak.
items.opportunity: Snaps, carries, routes, targets, red-zone all elite.

items.text: Jaguars intention for Travis Hunter clear: specialized package only (4 offensive snaps Week 1: jet, screens, decoy). Did not pass LOS on routes. Team actions (Meyers extension, no BTJ trade) signal limited offensive role.
items.why: Offseason moves and Week 1 usage show dual-threat but not primary WR route runner.
items.implication: Fantasy value capped short-term; more DB than WR currently.

items.text: Rashee Rice career aDOT 4.9 yards; Week 1 was 2.5. Needs serious volume. Only 2 targets (7% share) but routes were there: 29 of 33 Mahomes dropbacks (behind only Worthy 30).
items.why: Elite route participation but tiny aDOT and low target share; volume-dependent.
items.implication: ROS value hinges on target increase; high floor routes but efficiency risk.
items.opportunity: Route share already elite; target share expansion key.
